name: Matsuda (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Matsuda town emblem in blue: a disc bearing a white swirl of two comma-shaped waves.
history: Municipal flag of Matsuda, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 October 1968.

features.role: Matsuda town emblem — a disc bearing a white swirl of two comma-shaped waves
